title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 14 Part 1, MIC-Moral philosophy - EB.9
text:
U(r)—Maldi is forestiment employed as a touchline,
as a flux for ores of iron, and in the manufacture of
combus bottles. It is also employed for milliiness.
The ancient employed it in folopuary, for it would appear
pear that forms of their vales and flxtures were formed
of it.
